answer_1.quote: MAGNET enables an LLM to (1) generate robust sentence-level and token-level representations, (2) infill missing text spans while maintaining coherence with bidirectional context, (3) perform open-ended text generation without excessive repetition, and (4) preserve the knowledge acquired during pretraining.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates infilled text spans and open-ended text continuations based on given prefixes or missing segments.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the perplexity (PPL) of Llama-2-7B and MAGNET-adapted Llama-2-7B on the test set of ROC Stories and Wikitext-103.

answer_4.quote: Two human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk (with at least a high school diploma) then independently assessed whether each generated sentence was contextually appropriate and contributed to a coherent story.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assessed whether each generated sentence was contextually appropriate and contributed to a coherent story.
